Comment: WIDAL TEST <POSTIVE/NEGATIVE>

Antibody titre of 1:120 or higher suggests infection. A marked rise in the titre to one serotype to (above 1:120) or paired sample collected at 5 to 7 days interval is regarded as diagnostically significant. However persons who have received TAB vaccine may show high titre of antibodies to each of the salmonellae.
